children: Citi Trends said Friday that Finance Chief Heather Plutino has informed the company of her decision to step down from her role for personal reasons.
The off-price value retailer of apparel, accessories and home trends said Plutino will continue to serve as CFO while it conducts a search for her successor.
Plutino will assist in the transition when a new CFO is appointed.
